title: Reviewer Methodology Actions
description: Reviewer actions used in methodology reasoning.

entries.title: Identify
entries.description: Recognize the reviewer task that must happen first.

entries.title: Collect
entries.description: Gather literal evidence from the local chunk.

entries.title: Prioritize
entries.description: Rank stronger evidence above weaker signals.

entries.title: Resolve
entries.description: Resolve contradiction or ambiguity when evidence allows.

entries.title: Escalate
entries.description: Mark the case for more context or manual review.

entries.title: Classify
entries.description: Move from observation toward a reviewer conclusion.

entries.title: Generate
entries.description: Generate reviewer comments or a draft finding.

entries.title: Calibrate
entries.description: Adjust confidence to match the evidence.
